    Twists from contour functions #

    Words of Q_P (lists of arrows) give paths of the quiver of P (RayQuiver.toQPath). A contour function with values in Additive kˣ gives a twist of the linearization (RayQuiver.twistOf), and exact contour functions give exact twists. With Roiter's theorem, a twisted linearization of a chain-bounded ray category with cancellation is the linearization (RayQuiver.twistedLinEquiv_of_chainBounded).
